rules.instruction: When the description says that one or more of several optional actions may be selected, including that multiple actions may be performed together: Model the alternatives with an inclusive gateway so any nonempty combination of the actions can proceed.

rules.instruction: When the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with wording that preserves the described action and its object or result; do not substitute a related but different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description assigns work to both a human and an automated system within the same process: Represent each stated responsibility in the BPMN model, using lanes to distinguish the human and automated work and assigning activities to the appropriate lane.
rules.situation: the description assigns work to both a human and an automated system within the same process

rules.instruction: When the description states that a notification or milestone can occur after process work has begun: Model the later trigger within the ongoing process as an intermediate catch event, not as an independent process start event.
